title: 游戏模式
subtitle: Find the mode that fits your style

modes.name: Summoner's Rift
modes.description: The classic 5v5 map. Three lanes, two jungles, and one objective: victory.
modes.bestFor: Players who enjoy strategic gameplay, teamfighting, and objective control

modes.name: ARAM
modes.description: All Random All Mid. One lane, all random champions. Fast and chaotic.
modes.bestFor: Players who want fast-paced action with random champions

modes.name: One for All
modes.description: Everyone plays the same champion. Coordination and teamwork matter most.
modes.bestFor: Players who love coordination and mastering a single champion together

modes.name: Ultra Rapid Fire
modes.description: Super fast attacks and abilities. Pure chaos and fun.
modes.bestFor: Players who want a lighthearted break from normal gameplay

tips: Choose a mode that matches your playstyle and preferred pace of game
